errorCodes.meaning: The community owns no room with this identifier.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

MemberAction.description: What a member of a community-owned room may do there. `admin` is not among them: minting epochs, admitting and removing members are the community's, as the room's owner, and are exercised through the vtc/rooms/community/* tasks rather than by any member's credential. `curate` is not implied by `write`.
MemberAction.title: MemberAction

MemberActions.description: The actions granted, at least one. An empty list confers nothing rather than everything, and a schema that allowed it would make the more dangerous reading available to a careless consumer.
MemberActions.title: MemberActions

MemberStateV2.description: `MemberState` plus `suspended`. `offered`: credentials issued and waiting for the member to collect and accept them. `admitted`: accepted — on a sealed tier, the member is in the room's group. `suspended`: admitted, but the room was archived with `noAccess` (or scheduled for removal), so the room's host refuses the member's credentials; on a sealed tier they are still in the room's group. Restored to `admitted` with freshly issued credentials when the room leaves that state, and never restored if it is removed. `removed`: an administrator removed them, or withdrew their offer — archiving withdraws every open offer; on a sealed tier the room has advanced past an admitted member.
MemberStateV2.title: MemberStateV2

Response.description: Success response to vtc/rooms/community/members/list. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/rooms/community/members/list/0.2#response. One page of the room's members and offers, in every state including `suspended`.

nextCursor.description: Present when more remain; pass it as `cursor`.

Response.title: VTC Rooms Community Members List — response payload

validUntil.description: When the member's authority credential expires.
